windows: Close Spotify and exit from background system tray
Open Settings -> Apps -> Installed Apps -> Uninstall Spotify
Press Windows Key + R, type %localappdata% and delete the 'Spotify' folder
Press Windows Key + R, type %appdata% and delete the 'Spotify' folder
Restart your computer and download the latest installer from spotify.com/download
mac: Quit Spotify and drag Spotify from Applications to Trash
In Finder, click Go -> Go to Folder and enter ~/Library/Application Support
Delete the Spotify folder, empty Trash, and restart Mac
mobile: Go to device Settings -> Apps -> Spotify -> Storage -> Clear Data and Clear Cache
Uninstall the Spotify app and restart phone
Reinstall the latest build from Google Play Store or Apple App Store

steps: Tap the Settings (gear icon) in the top right corner
Note: Cleared cache frees device storage while retaining your downloaded offline playlists

sops.sop_name: Spotify Connect & Smart Speaker Disconnection Cycle
steps: Verify both phone and speaker are on the same 2.4GHz or 5GHz WiFi frequency
Restart your router and power-cycle the smart speaker (unplug for 30 seconds)
In the Alexa / Google Home app, disable the Spotify skill and re-enable it
Open Spotify -> Devices Available icon -> select your speaker
Go to spotify.com/account on a desktop or mobile browser
Scroll to the bottom of the Account Overview page
Wait 5 minutes and log back into your primary device
